title: Episode 41: Blockbuster Highs & Franchise Fatigue
recordedLocation: BMW X5 Studio • Overlooking Lady Bird Lake, Austin, TX

dialogue.speaker: Shane
dialogue.text: Welcome back inside the X5. Episode 41 is all about the summer blockbuster cycle and why so many two-hundred-million-dollar tentpoles look identical.

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: When every sequence relies on pre-visualization software and grey color grading, the emotional stakes vanish. We just watched four consecutive explosions with zero geographic continuity.

dialogue.speaker: Dave
dialogue.text: That's why Mad Max: Fury Road or Top Gun: Maverick stood out so fiercely. When you put real stunt drivers on real tarmac, the human brain registers the physical danger.
